SGPGIMS Location
Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences is located at New PMSSY Road, Raibareli Road, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. Sabha Kheda is the nearest bus stop which is 1.2 km away from the college. The nearest railway station is Utraitia Junction which is 5.5 km away from the college. The nearest airport to the college is Chaudhary Charan Singh International Airport which is 11.3 km away.

For the Master of Hospital Administration (MHA) course, SGPGIMS Lucknow admission requires candidates to qualify through an online computer-based test.

SGPGIMS MD/MS Admission Process
For admission into the SGPGIMS Lucknow PG courses, candidates need to fulfil the required eligibility criteria.
After that, candidates have to appear for
NEET PG
, conducted by NBE.
NBE will declare the result and will release the cutoff.
Candidates meeting the cutoff have to appear for counselling and give preference to SGPGIMS Lucknow.
The candidates have to report to the allotted college after the seats have been allotted to them during counselling.
Later, final admission is confirmed after the verification of documents and
SGPGIMS Lucknow fee
payment.
SGPGIMS Lucknow MHA Admission Process
Candidates are required to apply online for the MHA course and pay Rs 1,000 as the application fee.
After submitting the form, candidates are required to visit the SGPGI campus to take the computer-based entrance test.
The selection of the candidates will be made based on the entrance test scores. For the General Category, the minimum qualifying mark is 50% while for the reserved category candidates, it is 45% marks.
After the results, qualified candidates should visit SGPGIMS Lucknow for document verification and fee payment.
Thus, SGPGIMS Lucknow MHA admission is granted after successful verification and payment of fees.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's)
1
:
What is SGPGI Lucknow famous for?
Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences is known for its PG and doctoral programmes, high-quality medical education and a wide range of facilities and services.
2
:
Is SGPGI a government hospital or private?
Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences or SGPGIMS Lucknow is a state university established in 1983 under the UP Legislature Act.
3
:
When was the Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences established?
Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences was established in 1983 by  the Uttar Pradesh Legislature Act. It offers courses  in postgraduate and doctoral level.
4
:
Where is SGPGI located?
Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences is located in  Raebareli Road, 15 km from the main city Lucknow. It was established under the State Legislature Act in 1983 and is named after Sanjay Gandhi.
5
:
Is Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences recognised by UGC?
Yes, Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences (SGPGIMS) is recognised by the University Grants Commission (UGC) as a medical institute of national importance for higher education and research.
6
:
Is SGPGIMS Lucknow an autonomous institute?
Yes, SGPGIMS Lucknow is an autonomous institution. It operates under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, with an autonomous status to manage its academic and administrative functions.
7
:
What is the campus size of SGPGIMS Lucknow?
SGPGIMS Lucknow spans across a 550 acre campus, providing ample space for various medical and academic facilities, including research labs, hospitals, and residential areas for staff and students.
